title: Lentswe le le tswang kwa ntle ga toropo
intro: O eme mo motseng o go tlileng barongwa ba le bararo ka ditshupo tse di bonalang sentle, mme batho ba ba sotla mme ba ngaparetse mekgwa ya bone ya bogologolo. Go tswa kwa karolong e e kgakala thata ya motse, setshwantsho sengwe se tabogela kwa boidiiding, se tlhoka mowa e bile se ikemiseditse, go bua boammaaruri fa se lebane le go ganwa. Ke mang mowa o o neng wa tsenya sengwe le sengwe mo kotsing ka ntlha ya molaetsa e seng wa bone?
clues: Ke ne ke nna mo gare ga batho ba ba neng ba amogetse barongwa ba ba nang le ditshupo tse di bonalang sentle, le fa go ntse jalo ba ne ba fapoga ka boikgogomoso.
Ke ne ka tla ke tabogile ke tswa kwa karolong e e kgakala thata ya motse fa ke utlwa pitso ya barongwa.
Ke ne ka raya morafe wa me ka re: ‘Lona morafe wa me, latela barongwa. Latela ba ba sa go kopeng tuelo epe, ka gonne ba kaetswe sentle.’
Ke ne ke se moporofeti, mme ke ne ke dumela mo barongweng mme ka rotloetsa batho ba gaetsho go dira jalo.
Batho ba gaetsho ba ne ba sotla kgakololo ya me mme ba ntatofatsa ka gore ke motho yo o feteletsang dilo.
Fa ba mpolaya, Allah o ne a mpolelela gore ke tsene mo Paradaiseng, mme ke ne ke eletsa e kete batho ba me ba ka itse boitshwarelo le tlotlo e ke e amogetseng.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Monna yo o tswang kwa karolong e e kgakala thata ya motse (Ya-Sin) .
Mongwe wa barongwa ba bararo ba ba neng ba rometswe kwa motseng
Mogwebi yo o tlhageletseng wa motse ono
Mmusi wa motse
Moeteledipele wa baheitane
identity.answer: Monna yo o tswang kwa karolong e e kgakala thata ya motse (Ya-Sin) .

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: A rerela batho ba gagwe gore ba latele barongwa .
Go aga sekepe go boloka badumedi mo morwaleleng
Go latlhelwa mo molelong ka ntlha ya tumelo
Go mediwa ke leruarua
Go fiwa bogosi le botlhale
trial.answer: A rerela batho ba gagwe gore ba latele barongwa .

outcome.label: Botso
options: A tsena mo Paradaiseng mme a eletsa e kete batho ba gagwe ba ka itse boitshwarelo jwa gagwe
A nwela le batho ba gagwe ka ntlha ya go gana molaetsa
O ne a newa kgakgamatso ya kamela e namagadi

outcome.answer: A tsena mo Paradaiseng mme a eletsa e kete batho ba gagwe ba ka itse boitshwarelo jwa gagwe
